newsitem.title: UK: English China Clays maintain steady rally.
newsitem.headline: English China Clays maintain steady rally.

text.p: English China Clays Plc shares continued their recent rebound on Friday after the company issued a modestly upbeat trading statement.

The stock was up 7-1/2p at 185p by 0929 GMT. ECC shares dropped steadily from a year's high of 359p in February, to hit their lowest close in over five years of 168p on December 6, before making a tentative recovery.
"The statement was more positive than expected, or rather less negative than people were expecting," said one trader. "There were a few concerns around."
He said that many traders were waiting until after this morning's analysts meeting before making any moves on the stock. By 1027 GMT, only 264,376 shares had traded.
EEC said there had been some improvements in trading conditions in the second half and the international industrial conglomerate had begun to benefit from cost reduction initiatives.
As a result, margins had improved from their levels in the first half, though mineral sales volumes remained below their levels a year ago, the company said.
However, ECC said worldwide sales volumes for the second half were lower than in the same period last year, though the rate of decline had slowed to seven percent from 16 percent in the first half.
It said the paper cycle remained difficult to read, though the second quarter could mark the low in Europe and there was an expectation of firmer conditions in North America during 1997.
